From Principal's Desk
Dr. Manoj Kumar Hazarika, Principal
Tezpur College has been serving the people of North Bank of Brahmaputra in their pursuance of higher learning since 1965. The college has come a long way from a humble beginning to become an important institution of higher education in the state. The college is affiliated to Gauhati University and recognised under UGC 2(F) & 12 (B) . Tezpur College, which initially was one stream college of Arts only, now has commerce stream as well fulfilling a long pending demand since 2007. A college that has completed fifty glorious years in 2015 in imparting and expansion of higher education in the area has a long and distinguished past. The alumni from the college are well placed in various fields in different locations in the country as well as overseas. These distinguished and decorated alumni are the jewels of the college.
